stem.text: Four resistors are connected in a square as shown.

stem.alt: Square network of four resistors: 2 Ω (upper left), 4 Ω (upper right), 8 Ω (lower left) and 6 Ω (lower right); junctions labelled P (left), Q (top), R (right) and S (bottom).

stem.text: The resistance may be measured between any two junctions.
Between which two junctions is the measured resistance greatest?
